evidence: Workbook Quality Checks row 37 / Internal row 37 and quality-checks.md ### 36 require every distinctive value a criterion tells the judge to create to be absent from the seed and the reference's initial markup/state (owned by check-probe-not-in-seed.py, Deterministic row 24). Collected all 44 created sentinels across every judge.toml (JUDGE-CS1, W0, L1, M1, M2, WL0, WL1, R0, R1, R1B, R2, R3, RX, X0, X1, H0, H1, H1C, H2, H3, E1, F1, F2, P1, P2, P3, U1, U2, U3, D1, D2, O, LB, LG, LA, LR, LE, LV, T0, T1, S0, S1, S2 in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml; JUDGE-G1 in tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml); polish, visual and render create no probe values. grep -rn JUDGE over environment/, solution/ (server.js, public/app.js, index.html, CSS, seed copy) and instruction.md returns zero hits; the full message phrases (e.g. 'Lease question', 'Wall check', 'Before wall', 'Too late', 'Delete parent', 'Hold child', 'Version one', 'Hijack', 'See draft', 'Gone soon', 'Sent once', 'Order C', 'Live base', 'Persist', 'Gate check', 'Half typed', 'survey update', 'please review') also have zero hits. Both seed copies are byte-identical (sha256 f69616e2...be36) and the golden server.js only imports that seed (seedDatabase, lines 93-126), so the reference's initial state contains exactly the 17 seeded K-* messages, none of which carries a probe. State mutations the judge must cause are also not pre-satisfied: seeded walls are only M-12 -> dev (criteria add dev->M-13, sian->M-13, sian->M-11, all absent in seed); seeded timers are M-11=7, M-12=null, M-13=30 (persistence sets M-12 to 30 from off; timer_changes moves M-13 30->7->off->30); seeded holds are K-2, K-17, K-15, K-7 only (criteria hold new JUDGE-H1/JUDGE-S1 and release seeded K-17, which is held true in seed); seed has no '@Dev' mention so Dev's JUDGE-M2 mention must be created; the seed's read_up_to positions are superseded by the criterion's own read-then-post sequence for unread counts. Search probes do not collide by substring (JUDGE-O, JUDGE-D1, JUDGE-X0/X1, JUDGE-F1, JUDGE-W0 are not prefixes of any other probe that is searched), and the '-2' retry suffix rule (functional prompt.md lines 32-33) avoids collisions with an earlier attempt's text. Counterexample attempts: a dead app that renders seed only cannot show any JUDGE text or the new wall/hold/timer states, so no probe passes by pre-existence; a conforming alternative that seeds differently cannot be failed by this row since probes are judge-created. Note (not a defect for this row): test.sh (lines 98-102) does not delete a leftover /app/app.db; integration.md tells the builder to hand over without one, and a builder cannot know the JUDGE sentinels, so this does not pre-satisfy probes. This is a static source check; no judge run was needed to establish it.
